How do Kraken's Fury and Guinsoo's Rageblade builds compare on Aphelios? Are there good builds without Rageblade?

For this comparison, focus on two-star Aphelios boards where he carries exactly three ordinary completed items. First discover the remaining item pairs that actually appear; do not assume a particular pair. Compare Kraken's Fury without Rageblade, Rageblade without Kraken's Fury, and builds with both when the data supports them.

Use the available Set 18 standard-ranked final-board data.

requirements: Resolve the player-named holder and items against the active analysis scope, then investigate two-star, exactly three-item Aphelios loadouts. Describe the observed alternative triplets from the returned rows; paginate when more results are available and do not invent unsupported builds.

For build discovery, report each relevant triplet's board count and loadout pick rate with its Aphelios-holder denominator. Compare Kraken's Fury and Guinsoo's Rageblade packages using explicit holder-bound item cohorts, guarding against multiple Aphelios copies when combining item predicates.

Where possible, compare the same other-item pair across the Kraken's Fury and Rageblade alternatives inside shared observed companion or frontline conditions and final-level slices. Keep both-items builds separate from single-item alternatives. If there is no publicly supported common pair, report descriptive whole-build results and state that the one-slot contrast is unresolved.

For reportable comparisons, give boards, mean placement, top-four rate and win rate, plus returned effect intervals, overlap, suppression and warning information. Interpret lower mean placement as better and rates in their stated direction; do not treat a suppressed or missing row as zero.

State that exact whole-board equipment matching and global investment control are unavailable; disclose residual differences in companion investment. Do not reuse historical web results as current gold evidence or claim that an observed association proves item causation.

Support any exact same-holder multi-item claim with occurrence-bound loadout evidence or a one-copy guard across all stars plus separate star and item-count conditions; separate holder predicates can otherwise match items on different same-name copies.
expected_output.reference: Grade against the active scoped evidence actually returned. Either alternative may be favored; unsupported or suppressed estimates must be described as unresolved rather than as zero or as a fixed historical winner.

items.input:
With Bloodthirster and Infinity Edge on Brambleback, how does Titan's Resolve compare with Edge of Night for the last slot?

Compare two-star Brambleback carrying exactly three ordinary completed items: Bloodthirster and Infinity Edge plus either Titan's Resolve or Edge of Night. Keep all three items on that single holder; the named pair is fixed even if either build is rare.

Use the available Set 18 standard-ranked final-board data.

requirements: Resolve Brambleback and the four named items against the active analysis scope. Check two-star, three-item Brambleback loadouts containing the fixed Bloodthirster and Infinity Edge pair, and determine whether each named third-item triplet has reportable support. Preserve the specified pair even when rare.

Compare the exact Titan's Resolve and Edge of Night alternatives with holder-bound item conditions and a one-Brambleback-copy guard for joint predicates. Use shared observed final-level and core conditions where supported; use returned companion/frontline loadouts to describe remaining investment rather than asserting exact whole-board equality.

Report each cohort's board count and, where available, histogram, mean placement, top-four rate and win rate, together with returned target-minus-baseline effects and intervals, overlap, suppression and warnings. Distinguish an explicitly empty cohort from a missing or suppressed result; do not substitute item marginals for this fixed-build comparison.

Interpret lower mean placement as better and report rates in their stated direction. If one or both alternatives lack reportable samples, say which comparison cannot be estimated; do not infer zero performance or force a winner.

Treat the execution scope's Set 18 standard-ranked patch and collection provenance as a preflight requirement for post-September-24/28 interpretation because calls have no date or subpatch filter. Do not infer cast timing or stack speed from placement outcomes.

Support any exact same-holder multi-item claim with occurrence-bound loadout evidence or a one-copy guard across all stars plus separate star and item-count conditions; separate holder predicates can otherwise match items on different same-name copies.
expected_output.reference: Grade against the active scoped evidence actually returned. Either alternative may be favored; if support is insufficient, report the specific missing or suppressed comparison without converting it to zero or borrowing historical item marginals.
